turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
do I use it properly the very first time?
For the first use:



Read the warmer instructions first.


Put it on a safe surface and plug it in.


If it has separate pieces, set the bowl on the base.


Add wax — for Happy Wax bears, start with 1–2 bears in an Outlet warmer.


Do not add water or oil.


Turn it on, or set the timer if it has one.



If your warmer uses a bulb, make sure to remove any plastic around the bulb first.
If you have any other questions or need more tips, just let me know!
